title: Themed Product Page

fields.label: Themed layout — settings
fields.instructions: Turn the use-case theme switcher on for this product. Each theme below is a tab; a theme shows in the switcher when it's enabled.

fields.label: Enable themed layout
fields.name: tp_enable
fields.instructions: Show the theme switcher (above the gallery) on this product's page. Off = normal product page.

fields.label: Auto-show theme popup
fields.name: tp_popup_autoshow
fields.instructions: When a theme is active, auto-open its popup once per visitor.

fields.label: Switcher intro (optional)
fields.name: tp_switcher_intro
fields.instructions: Small label shown before the theme tabs, e.g. “See it as…”.

fields.label: Show this theme
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_enable
fields.instructions: Include this theme in the switcher.

fields.label: Theme name
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_name
fields.instructions: Label on the switcher tab.

fields.label: Theme slug (optional)
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_slug
fields.instructions: URL value for ?theme= (leave empty to derive from the name).

fields.label: Banner image
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_banner_image
fields.instructions: Themed hero banner background.

fields.label: Headline highlight word
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_headline_highlight
fields.instructions: The highlighted word (yellow underline).

fields.label: Gallery shots
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_gallery
fields.instructions: Staged photos for this theme (shown in the product gallery).

fields.label: Image features
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_features
fields.instructions: Feature cards specific to this theme.

fields.label: Checklist
fields.name: tp_cyclehub_checklist
fields.instructions: Ticked feature list for this theme.
